rationale: Build on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline by shifting late-stage EMA toward tensors that are most likely to matter after int8+zlib export: all kept-float tensors plus deeper tail QKV/full-block weights and recurrent control scalars. This is a compact export-aligned structural edit, not another scalar sweep, and it directly targets the recurrent-tail/quantization endgame that remains the strongest local signal.
title: Tail-Selective EMA Expansion
